description: This file is a Java interface (VisitDAO) defining database access methods for managing visit entities within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes method signatures for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching for visits, visit types, visit attributes, and related entities.

classes.name: VisitDAO
classes.description: A Java interface defining data access object methods for visit-related operations in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all visit types, with an option to include retired types.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Fetches a specific VisitType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Searches for visit types matching a fuzzy search phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Persists a VisitType entity to the database.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Deletes a VisitType from the database.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Visit by its UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Saves or updates a Visit record.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits based on multiple filtering criteria including types, patients, locations, indicators, date ranges, attributes, and flags for inactive or voided visits.

methods.name: getVisits (with VisitSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves visits matching the specified search criteria object.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: deleteVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a VisitAttributeType from the database.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: getNextVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the next active Visit that matches specified VisitType(s) and start date criteria.
